HubfloAPIKeyCredential.title: Hubflo API Key
HubfloAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: In Hubflo, open organization settings → Integrations → Generate key. Paste the API key here. NoClick sends it as a bearer token to app.hubflo.com.

template_id.description: ID of a task template to instantiate the task from. When provided, the task is created from the template (its name, description, assignments, tags, custom fields, files and subtasks are copied) and the template attributes take precedence over the other attributes.
template_id.title: Template Id

project_section_id.description: Only project sections that are not templates can be used. Deprecated: attaching a task to a non-template project section is deprecated.
project_section_id.title: Project Section Id

workspace_id.description: Deprecated: attaching a task to a non-template workspace is deprecated.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

recurrence_type.description:
Recurrence kind. Send `null` to remove an existing rule. Other
`recurrence_*` attributes depend on this type.
recurrence_type.title: Recurrence Type

creator_type.description: Filter by creator type (user or contact)
creator_type.title: Creator Type

parent_id.description:
Filter by parent task ID. If not provided, the endpoint will return
first level tasks (no subtasks).
parent_id.title: Parent Id
